experiment_data.method_description: DJ-1⁻/⁻ MEF cells stably transfected with [wt]DJ-1, [M26I]DJ-1, [C106A]DJ-1, [C46A]DJ-1, [C53A]DJ-1, or pcDNA-Zeo vector control were transiently transfected with pRK5-FLAG-Daxx. After treatment with or without 500 μM H₂O₂, cells were fixed and stained with anti-FLAG (Alexa568) and Hoechst 33342 for nuclear counterstaining.

negative_positive_control.negative_control_description: pcDNA-Zeo vector control as negative control (cytosolic staining: ~80% after H₂O₂).
negative_positive_control.positive_control_description: [wt]DJ-1 as positive control for Daxx nuclear retention (cytosolic staining: ~20% after H₂O₂).
